summary: DEPLOY READINESS & REAL CLIENT VALIDATION SPRINT — Full backend + frontend certification. 22/22 backend tests pass. All core business flows verified via UI. Key issues: begin-journey endpoint is /api/public/journeys/initiate (not /api/journey-initiate/begin), /api/leads/ trailing slash causes 307 redirect that drops auth headers (use /api/leads without slash), /blueprint/partner-network route doesn't exist (correct route is /partner-network).

minor.issue: 307 redirect drops Authorization header in some HTTP clients. Tests must use /api/leads (no trailing slash). Actual endpoint works correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows '404 This page does not exist' when not authenticated (before login redirect completes). After auth, correctly shows CMS Pagine admin. NOT a real 404 - just race condition before auth state loads.

Clicking project card image at the top (img element) triggers user profile dropdown instead of selecting the project. Must click the card text/container area below the image. Expected: entire card should be clickable.
Console error: 'Cannot update a component (LocalizationOverlay) while rendering a different component (Sidebar)'. React setState-in-render violation. Non-blocking but worth fixing.
'Upstream temporarily unavailable' toast appears intermittently in Blueprint. Suggests occasional backend connectivity issue - not consistent.

integration_issues.issue: Route /blueprint/partner-network does NOT exist. Correct route is /partner-network. Documentation/test spec refers to wrong URL.

action_items: MEDIUM: ProjectsStudioPage - clicking project card image opens user profile dropdown instead of selecting the project. Consider making entire card clickable (not just the text area below image). Pointer events on image may be too broad.
LOW: Fix React setState-in-render violation in Sidebar/LocalizationOverlay component

INFO: Correct journey initiation endpoint is POST /api/public/journeys/initiate with nested {welcome: {email, first_name, last_name}, tenant_slug, atmosphere} payload - NOT /api/journey-initiate/begin
INFO: /api/leads/ trailing slash causes 307 redirect that drops auth headers - always use /api/leads (no trailing slash) in test clients
INFO: Partner Network admin page route is /partner-network (not /blueprint/partner-network)
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar has a React anti-pattern: setState called during render of another component (LocalizationOverlay → Sidebar). Should be refactored to use useEffect for state updates.
Project card click area: The card's onClick handler should cover the entire card area including the image. Currently clicking on the image triggers a different action (user profile dropdown opened).
/api/leads/ and /api/leads both exist due to FastAPI route definition - trailing slash 307 redirect is expected FastAPI behavior but can catch clients that follow redirects and drop auth headers.

card_click_issue.root_cause: ProjectsStudioPage project card has an img element that captures pointer events. When clicking on the image area, Playwright's force click might be intercepted by the user profile avatar button (top right) or the image itself has a different handler.
card_click_issue.observation: The detail panel shows 'Seleziona un progetto dal pannello sinistro' after clicking the card image, but clicking at coordinates (210, 535) - the TEXT area below the image - correctly loads the project detail.
card_click_issue.mitigation: Use coordinate-based click on text area of card, or add data-testid to card container to enable clean click targeting
